title: Daam-, FMNL-, and mDia-family formins jointly regulate cortical actin dynamics in melanoma cells.
authors: Kaufmann, Thomas; Scholz, Jonas; Csiszar, Agnes; Karger, Marius; Walkenbach, Moritz; Rottner, Klemens; Merkel, Rudolf; Curth, Ute; Faix, Jan
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用CRISPR/Cas9敲除研究formin蛋白在黑色素瘤细胞皮层肌动蛋白动力学中的功能，但仅将CRISPR作为基因编辑工具，未涉及切割机制或碱基编辑，与本课题核心无关。
abstract: The actin-rich cell cortex is a viscoelastic structure essential for processes such as cell migration and division, yet the full spectrum of actin assembly factors that build and regulate the cortex in mammalian cells remains incompletely defined. While the Arp2/3 complex generates actin networks mostly comprising short, branched filaments, formins like mDia1 and mDia3 assemble long, linear filaments capable of withstanding the high mechanical load produced by myosin-driven contraction at the cell rear. To obtain a complete inventory of formins that regulate mechanics of the contractile cortex in B16-F1 melanoma cells, we systematically screened Diaphanous-related formins (DRFs) for interactions with Rho-family GTPases regulating contractility. This screen led to the identification of Daam1/2 and FMNL2/3 as cortical formins, since active variants of these formins as well as the endogenous proteins prominently localized to the rear cortex of polarized B16-F1 cells. Yeast two-hybrid (Y2H) and GST pull-down assays revealed prominent interactions of Daam1/2 with active RhoA, RhoB, RhoC, RhoD, and Cdc42, and weaker binding to Rac1 and Rif. Pyrene-actin polymerization and single-filament TIRF assays further demonstrated that these GTPases effectively relieve autoinhibition of Daam-family formins, with Daam1 and 2 emerging as a potent elongators. In line with this, CRISPR/Cas9-generated Daam1/2 double-knockout cells exhibited multiple defects, including formation of multiple leading edges, impaired random 2D migration, reduced focal adhesion (FA) turnover and inefficient rear retraction. However, contrary to earlier work, we found no evidence that Daam1/2 regulate the formation of finger-like protrusions. By comparison, FMNL2 appears to act as a dual-role formin at both the cell front and rear, interacting with and being activated by several GTPases linked to contractility and protrusion. Analytical ultracentrifugation further clarified previous inconsistencies by showing that the affinity of FMNL2 for GTPases, particularly for Rac1, depends on the length of its N-terminal fragment and the presence of the full FH3 domain. Finally, we show that cells lacking Daam1/2 and mDia1/3 display pronounced cortical defects, including reduced rigidity, excessive blebbing, and delayed cytokinesis, demonstrating that these formins cooperate to preserve cortical architecture and function.
abstract_zh: 富含肌动蛋白的细胞皮层是一种黏弹性结构，对细胞迁移和分裂等过程至关重要，然而在哺乳动物细胞中，构建和调控皮层的肌动蛋白组装因子的完整谱系仍未完全明确。Arp2/3复合体主要生成由短分支丝组成的肌动蛋白网络，而诸如mDia1和mDia3之类的formin则组装长直丝，能够承受细胞后部由肌球蛋白驱动的收缩所产生的高机械负荷。为获得调控B16-F1黑色素瘤细胞收缩性皮层力学的formin完整清单，我们系统筛选了Diaphanous相关formin (DRFs) 与调控收缩性的Rho家族GTPases之间的相互作用。该筛选鉴定出Daam1/2和FMNL2/3为皮层formin，因为这些formin的活性变体以及内源蛋白显著定位于极化B16-F1细胞的后部皮层。酵母双杂交 (Y2H) 和GST pull-down实验揭示了Daam1/2与活性RhoA、RhoB、RhoC、RhoD和Cdc42的显著相互作用，以及与Rac1和Rif的较弱结合。芘标记肌动蛋白聚合和单丝TIRF实验进一步证明，这些GTPases有效解除Daam家族formin的自抑制，其中Daam1和2表现为强效延伸因子。与此一致，CRISPR/Cas9生成的Daam1/2双敲除细胞表现出多种缺陷，包括形成多个前缘、随机二维迁移受损、黏着斑 (FA) 周转减少以及后部回缩效率低下。然而，与早期研究相反，我们未发现Daam1/2调控指状突起形成的证据。相比之下，FMNL2似乎在细胞前部和后部均扮演双重角色formin，与多种与收缩性和突起相关的GTPases相互作用并被其激活。分析超速离心进一步澄清了先前的不一致之处，表明FMNL2对GTPases（特别是Rac1）的亲和力取决于其N端片段的长度以及完整FH3结构域的存在。最后，我们显示缺乏Daam1/2和mDia1/3的细胞表现出显著的皮层缺陷，包括刚性降低、过度起泡和胞质分裂延迟，证明这些formin协同作用以维持皮层结构和功能。
